drafts.title: City support and agreements involving named organizations
drafts.text: All agreements, memoranda, grants, fee waivers, purchase orders, permits, inspection records, leases, licenses, utility payments or credits, property-use authorizations, equipment loans, and in-kind support from January 1, 2019 through the search date concerning Rick Aldridge, Oklahoma Emergency Response Team Inc., OKERT, Good Neighbor Project, Good Neighbor Coalition, Ottawa County Community Connections, or Chuck Stotts Big Santa Program. Please include records sufficient to identify the recipient, date, amount or stated value, public purpose, approving authority, and funding source.

drafts.title: City communications concerning the named programs
drafts.text: Email, text messages, letters, meeting notes, and attachments from January 1, 2019 through the search date between elected officials, the City Manager, City Clerk, Housing Authority liaisons, emergency management, parks or facilities staff, and Rick Aldridge or representatives of Oklahoma Emergency Response Team Inc., OKERT, Good Neighbor Project, Good Neighbor Coalition, Ottawa County Community Connections, or Chuck Stotts Big Santa Program. This request excludes purely personal messages unrelated to public business.

drafts.title: County partnerships, support, and emergency-management records
drafts.text: All agreements, grants, reimbursements, donated property or equipment, emergency-management tasking, spring-cleanup partnership records, facility arrangements, purchase orders, and communications from January 1, 2019 through the search date concerning Rick Aldridge, Oklahoma Emergency Response Team Inc., OKERT, Good Neighbor Project, or Good Neighbor Coalition. Please include records sufficient to identify each transaction or in-kind contribution and the approving public body.

drafts.title: Charitable-solicitation registration and enforcement records
drafts.text: Charitable-solicitation registrations, claimed exemptions, annual reports, consent agreements, final enforcement actions, and closed complaints available for public inspection concerning Oklahoma Emergency Response Team Inc. (EIN 46-5454378) and Good Neighbor Coalition (EIN 93-3781759). Please identify any responsive category withheld and the legal basis for withholding it.

drafts.title: Exemption applications and determination files
drafts.text: Publicly disclosable exemption applications, supporting schedules, determination letters, and available Form 990-N e-postcard history for Oklahoma Emergency Response Team Inc. (EIN 46-5454378) and Good Neighbor Coalition (EIN 93-3781759). This draft should be routed through the IRS tax-exempt-organization disclosure process rather than an Oklahoma open-records form.
